name: price-signal-film
description: PRICE / SIGNAL motion film: 2:36 horizontal + 0:45 vertical, data-driven scenes, voice-ready timeline. All data fictional.

scripts.render:film: remotion render src/index.ts Film out/price-signal-film.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --pixel-format yuv420p --color-space=bt709
scripts.render:film-captioned: remotion render src/index.ts FilmCaptioned out/price-signal-film-captioned.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --pixel-format yuv420p --color-space=bt709
scripts.render:film-voice: remotion render src/index.ts FilmVoice out/price-signal-film-voice.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --pixel-format yuv420p --color-space=bt709 --audio-codec aac
scripts.render:vertical: remotion render src/index.ts Vertical out/price-signal-vertical.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --pixel-format yuv420p --color-space=bt709
scripts.render:vertical-voice: remotion render src/index.ts VerticalVoice out/price-signal-vertical-voice.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --pixel-format yuv420p --color-space=bt709 --audio-codec aac
scripts.render:stills: remotion still src/index.ts Thumbnail out/youtube-thumbnail.png && remotion still src/index.ts OgCover out/og-cover.png && remotion still src/index.ts Square out/linkedin-1080.png && remotion still src/index.ts Film out/film-poster.png --frame=3190

scripts.render:film-es-voice: remotion render src/index.ts FilmEsVoice out/price-signal-film-es-voice.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --pixel-format yuv420p --color-space=bt709 --audio-codec aac
scripts.render:vertical-es-voice: remotion render src/index.ts VerticalEsVoice out/price-signal-vertical-es-voice.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --pixel-format yuv420p --color-space=bt709 --audio-codec aac
